# Vendor Info: Ace Editor

- **Project**: [Ajax.org Cloud9 Editor](https://github.com/ajaxorg/ace)
- **Version**: 1.45.2
- **License**: BSD-3-Clause
- **Distribution**: [jsDelivr npm registry](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package/npm/ace-builds)

**How to update**
1. Open the central `updater.html` tool in your browser.
2. Click "Choose parent folder" and select the root directory (e.g. `vendor/`).
3. Select **Ace Editor** from the dropdown menu.
4. Click "Download Target Version". The tool will automatically target the `vendor/ace-builds/` subfolder, create it if needed, and write the updated files.
5. Update [sw.js](../../sw.js), [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](../../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and [README.md](../../README.md) with generated related snippets.
